loader-mode.title: Not available in the Free Edition
loader-mode.body: The loader setting cannot be changed in the Free Edition. You can only export projects using the Construct splash. Purchase a plan to remove all of the Free Edition limits.

remote-preview.title: Remote Preview is not available in the Free Edition
remote-preview.body: Remote Preview allows you to quickly and easily test your project on different devices. It's particularly useful for trying out your project on mobile devices. Purchase a plan to access this feature.

restricted-plugin.title: Not available in the Free Edition
restricted-plugin.body: This plugin is not available in the Free Edition. Purchase a plan to access all plugins in Construct.

event-search.title: Not available in the Free Edition
event-search.body: Searching event sheets and project files is not available in the Free Edition. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

find-all-references.title: Not available in the Free Edition
find-all-references.body: [i]Find All References[/i] allows you to instantly see a list of everywhere something is used in your project. It's great for reviewing your work. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

live-preview.title: Not available in the Free Edition
live-preview.body: [i]Live Preview[/i] allows you to see a preview of an object or behavior directly in the editor, without having to preview the project. It's great for getting effects right, such as with the Particles object. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

zorder-bar.title: Not available in the Free Edition
zorder-bar.body: The Z Order Bar allows you to easily edit which objects appear in front or behind others. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

bookmarks-bar.title: Not available in the Free Edition
bookmarks-bar.body: The Bookmarks Bar allows you to save locations in event sheets and easily navigate between them. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

families.title: Not available in the Free Edition
families.body: [i]Families[/i] help eliminate repeated events for similar objects. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

project-subfolders.title: Not available in the Free Edition
project-subfolders.body: Using subfolders in the Project Bar helps you keep your project organized. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

breakpoints.title: Not available in the Free Edition
breakpoints.body: Breakpoints allow you to pause on an event when using the debugger. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

data-editor.title: Not available in the Free Edition
data-editor.body: The data editors allow you to edit Array and Dictionary data directly in the editor. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

text-editor.title: Not available in the Free Edition
text-editor.body: The text editor allows you to edit text files directly in the editor. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

webfont-limit.title: Not available in the Free Edition
webfont-limit.body: You cannot add more Web Fonts in the Free Edition. Purchase a plan to remove all of the Free Edition limits.

bundled-addons.title: Not available in the Free Edition
bundled-addons.body: Bundling addons with a project allows you to open the project anywhere without having to first install the addons it uses. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

onion-skin.title: Not available in the Free Edition
onion-skin.body: Onion skinning allows you to see translucent copies of the next and previous frames while editing the current animation frame. It's a great help for drawing animations. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

export-manager.title: Not available in the Free Edition
export-manager.body: The Export Manager allows you to review and build the last few exports from Construct, as well as build projects exported from Construct 2. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

theme.title: Not available in the Free Edition
theme.body: Changing the theme allows you to customise the appearance of Construct, such as by using a dark theme. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

script-limit.title: Not available in the Free Edition
script-limit.body: You cannot write more JavaScript in the Free Edition. Purchase a plan to remove all of the Free Edition limits.

mesh-editor-limit.title: Mesh editing limit reached
mesh-editor-limit.body: You cannot edit more than one mesh in a project in the Free Edition. Purchase a plan to remove all of the Free Edition limits.

export-video-limit.title: Export limit reached
export-video-limit.body: You cannot export a video or GIF longer than 5 seconds in the Free Edition. Purchase a plan to remove all of the Free Edition limits.

export-image-sequence-limit.title: Export image sequence limit reached
export-image-sequence-limit.body: You cannot export an image sequence longer than 5 seconds in the Free Edition. Purchase a plan to remove all of the Free Edition limits.

minify-script.title: Not available in the Free Edition
minify-script.body: Minifying script reduces the size of the exported JavaScript code, making the project quicker to load and harder to reverse engineer. Purchase a plan to use this feature.

generic.title: Not available in the Free Edition
generic.body: This feature is not available in the Free Edition of Construct. Purchase a plan to start using it.

create-keystore-report-dialog.caption: Successfully created keystore
create-keystore-report-dialog.keep-it-safe: Because your app signing key is used to verify your identity as a developer and to ensure seamless and secure updates for your users, managing your key and keeping it secure are very important, both for you and for your users. [b]If you lose access to your app signing key[/b] or your key is compromised, Google cannot retrieve the app signing key for you, and [b]you will not be able to release new versions of your app[/b] to users as updates to the original app.
create-keystore-report-dialog.we-dont-store-it: When using the build service a copy of your keystore will be transferred to the build server temporarily, and deleted once the build has completed. [b]Neither C3 or Scirra hold a copy of any keystore[/b] created or used by the build service. [b]You must keep your keystore in a safe and secure place.[/b]
create-keystore-report-dialog.google-play-app-signing: If you are worried about the possibility of losing your signing key, you can use Google Play App Signing. This makes use of 2 keys instead of 1; an upload key and a signing key. When you use this service the Play Store verifies the key you used to sign your game for upload, then it signs it a second time with the signing key that Google stores securely. If you lose your upload key, or if it is compromised, you can contact Google to revoke your old upload key and generate a new one. Because your app signing key is secured by Google, you can continue to upload new versions of your app as updates to the original app, even if you change upload keys.
create-keystore-report-dialog.more-information: You can find more information about signing Android applications at:
create-keystore-report-dialog.signature: Your SHA-1 signature is [b]{0}[/b]. It's worth writing this down, as you will need it to use some plugins like Google Play.
